claim_ceiling: This artifact measures the ordering of the JANUS/Kem narrative archive and uses Tenet as an analogy for provenance reconstruction. It does not claim that real-world causality, entropy, or time is physically inverted.

notes.PHALLUS_PRESERVED_OR_CONTAINED_HYPOTHESI: User lore hypothesis; not established archaeology.
notes.KEM_FINDS_OR_IDENTIFIES_RELIC: Future target state inferred from the sender role; not yet historically or archaeologically established.
notes.SET_RECEIVES_AND_ORDERS: Represents the already-created message to Set in which the restored relic/result appears before the causal search has been completed.

causal_inversion_metric.interpretation: Within this seven-node lore/archive model, about 85.7% of pairwise relations are displayed in the opposite order from the reconstructed causal order. The sequence is therefore strongly, but not perfectly, inverted.
causal_inversion_metric.invariant_interpretation: The Sobek gate is the local causal island that remained correctly ordered while the larger story was assembled backwards. This makes Sobek a useful anchor for reconstruction, not evidence of supernatural causality.

tenet_analogy.turnstile_equivalent: The project crossed its narrative turnstile when it encoded a future/result state — 'the relic is restored and sent onward' — before establishing recovery, containment, or the original loss locus.
tenet_analogy.temporal_pincer_equivalent: Run the myth/history forward from dismemberment while running museum provenance backward from current objects/labels. The two tracks must meet at the same independently supported loss/containment node before a candidate can advance.
tenet_analogy.what_happened_happened_rule: Do not rewrite source evidence to fit the desired relic. Any candidate must satisfy the surviving evidence chain as found.

highest_confidence_direct_late_witness.event: The male member is the one part Isis does not recover; it is said to have been tossed into the river and consumed by lepidotus, phagrus and oxyrhynchus fish.
highest_confidence_direct_late_witness.confidence_note: Late Greek witness preserving an important tradition, not a direct pharaonic excavation report.

peer_reviewed_egyptology_reframe.source: Cathie Spieser, Le phallus d'Osiris, Archimede HS2
peer_reviewed_egyptology_reframe.finding: The oxyrhynchus fish can function as a divine receptacle of the organ; later Egyptian material also preserves reconstructed relic-simulacra, reliquary vessels and local phallus cult traditions.
peer_reviewed_egyptology_reframe.implication: The 'loss' node may branch into biological-loss, fish-receptacle, ritual-reconstruction and reliquary traditions rather than one surviving flesh object.

loss_event_resolution.do_not_invent: No current source gives a defensible exact point on the Nile where Seth/Typhon threw the organ.

post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.evidence: Papyrus Brooklyn 47.218.84, as published by Meeks and discussed in later Egyptology, describes the Mendesian Osiris phallus as the 'copulating Ba' and associates the divine flesh with the virile member and spine/back. Dendera-related relic traditions include a ram-headed reliquary vessel for the 16th Lower Egyptian nome.
post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.search_implication: Prioritize reliquaries, ram-headed/Atef containers, Banebdjedet-Osiris material, gilded/metal tokens, internal container contents and objects with body-part terminology.

post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.evidence: Spieser citing Beinlich records a phallus-and-testicles cult/relic tradition for the 7th Upper Egyptian nome and an anthropomorphic double-crown reliquary vessel.
post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.search_implication: Resolve the ancient toponym Kenem and its modern archaeological site before object-level searching. Do not map a guessed coordinate.

post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.evidence: The oxyrhynchus/mormyrid fish is one of the late-account consumers and is treated in Egyptological synthesis as a divine receptacle motif; Oxyrhynchus also has strong local fish cult and Osirian material traditions.
post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.search_implication: Search fish reliquaries, Osirian deposits and ritual objects while keeping fish-cult controls separate.

post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.evidence: Dendera representations document reconstructed Osirian phallus relic-simulacra and their reliquary vessels across multiple nomes.
post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.search_implication: Use Dendera inscriptions as a routing table: extract nome, vessel morphology, crown/head type, body-part pairing and associated deities before searching collections.

post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.evidence: Abydos is a major Osiris cult center and Djer's tomb was later treated as a tomb of Osiris.
post_loss_localization_nodes_ranked.search_implication: Keep Abydos as the strongest symbolic/historical return destination after authentication, but do not confuse return address with the original loss locus.

haw_7_reordered_execution.previous_start: Broad catalogue scan beginning with Abydos fragments and generic object classes.
haw_7_reordered_execution.new_start: First reconstruct the post-loss localization network, then search the object classes attached to those nodes.
ordered_steps: 1. MENDES: bind Papyrus Brooklyn 47.218.84 passage -> Dendera/Beinlich 16th-nome reliquary -> excavation/catalogue objects from Tell el-Rub'a.
2. NOME 7: resolve Kenem location -> bind phallus+testicles tradition -> anthropomorphic double-crown reliquary morphology -> museum/excavation records.
3. OXYRHYNCHUS: separate fish-receptacle motif from ordinary fish cult -> inspect Osirian catacomb/deposit objects and containers.
4. DENDERA: build a body-part/reliquary routing table for all phallus-related procession entries.

5. Only after the routing table is frozen, run representation-agnostic catalogue matching: gold/electrum medallion-like tokens, amulets, internal statuette contents, linen/prosthetic replacements, reliquaries, unidentified fragments.
6. Preserve Abydos as return-address and independent control branch, not as an assumed loss site.
haw_7_reordered_execution.candidate_promotion_gate: A candidate advances only if at least two independent dimensions converge: (A) Osiris/body-part/relic semantics, (B) secure site/provenance, (C) container/replacement function, (D) compatible material/form. Shape alone cannot pass.
